cards.name: Goldberry, River-Daughter
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Move a counter of each kind not on Goldberry from another target permanent you control onto Goldberry.
{U}, {T}: Move one or more counters from Goldberry onto another target permanent you control. If you do, draw a card.

rulings.comment: To move a counter from one permanent to another, the counter is removed from the first permanent and put on the second. Any abilities that care about a counter being removed from or put onto a permanent will apply.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
